Bill.BriefDescription: Removing the expiration date from community protection zone provisions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reestablishing community protection zones;repealing 2005 c 436 s 4 (uncodified); and repealing 2005 c 436 s 6(uncodified).
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: 2005 c 436 s 4 (uncodified); and 2005 c 436 s 6 (uncodified).
